codec_fit: Family-wise centered unscaled PCA, deterministic SVD on fit-role canonical states only. Fixed widths; decoder clipped to occupancy [0,1]. No hyperparameter/arm selection on development or fresh. No fitting of P.
reference: Canonical64 history and future; canonical32 numeric control. P_history_oracle is continuous P-conditioned state. Physical_identity supplies canonical gates at restart: a privileged state-available diagnostic, not V/Ca-only deployment. All arms share the same future V and external Ca.
restart_environment: Save V/Ca immediately before each cut. At restart the common prescribed future V/Ca may jump; that is a matched voltage/calcium clamp intervention, not membrane or dynamic calcium simulation. Ca remains explicit/exogenous, never folded into an inferred latent state.
warmup: Only preceding observed V/Ca prefix, initialized from fixed standard state at -65mV,5e-5mM. Warmup400 is capped by available prefix at earlier cuts and must exactly reproduce P_history_oracle. No future samples or hidden teacher gates enter warmup. Explicit V,Ca and parameters are retained for all arms.
measurement: Streaming full-prefix current NRMSE/NMAX, signed and absolute charge errors and gate RMSE/max against canonical64; paired current/state differences against P_history_oracle isolate initialization from inherited P error. Original quality limits copied verbatim. Event/coupled-system qualification is not claimed in this initialization-only experiment. Fixed negative shuffle and exact restart controls. Save states, fitted codecs, scalar metrics and selected witness traces, not full multi-GB trajectories.

cost.scope: Resident initialization only: actual frozen P forward replay for each warmup budget and physical encoding+decoding on GPU. Excludes dataset generation and transfer; joint evaluation reuses state-independent P coefficients but does not claim that reuse as production speedup.
